mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organizations (organization_name, parent_id, admin_user_id, created_at, deleted_at, addr_street1, addr_street2, city, state, country_code, postal_code, timezone) VALUES (#{organizationName}, #{parentId}, #{adminUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{deletedAt}, #{address.addrStreet1}, #{address.addrStreet2}, #{address.city}, #{address.state}, #{address.countryCode}, #{address.postalCode}, #{address.timezone})
mapper.select: SELECT organization_id, organization_name, parent_id, admin_user_id, created_at, deleted_at, addr_street1, addr_street2, city, state, country_code, postal_code, timezone FROM organizations WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET organization_name = #{organizationName}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, parent_id = #{parentId}, admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}, addr_street1 = #{address.addrStreet1}, addr_street2 = #{address.addrStreet2}, city = #{address.city}, state = #{address.state}, country_code = #{address.countryCode}, postal_code = #{address.postalCode}, timezone = #{address.timezone} WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
